newsitem.title: USA: Zapata says Envirodyne bid proves serious.
newsitem.headline: Zapata says Envirodyne bid proves serious.

text.p: Zapata Corp said it launched a takeover bid for Envirodyne Industries Inc in effort to prove it is serious about its commitment to the company.

Envirodyne management "invited us on more than one occasion in the past to make an offer. We decided we'd put our money where our mouth is," Executive Vice President Joseph von Rosenberg told Reuters.

Zapata, which owns 40.4 percent of Envirodyne, earlier launched a cash and stock takeover bid valued at $8 per share, or $640 million including debt. The bid is conditioned on the election of Zapata's slate to the Envirodyne board.
Zapata sent a letter to Envirodyne executives on Wednesday morning to advise them of the bid but has not had any contact with the company since then, Von Rosenberg said.
Envirodyne could not be reached for comment. The company has urged shareholders to vote against the Zapata slate.
Von Rosenberg said the decision to launch a bid followed several recent Zapata board meetings. The company is being advised by Bear Stearns & Co.
